name: Llapingachos
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, drain very well and mash smooth. Mix with 5 g salt and half the achiote oil; cool until handleable.
Divide mash into eight portions. Flatten, add cheese in the centre, seal and shape into thick patties; chill 15 minutes.
Soften onion in a little achiote oil for 5 minutes. Whisk in peanut butter, milk, cumin and remaining salt; simmer 5 minutes into a pourable sauce.
Pan-fry patties in remaining oil 4–5 minutes per side until brown and crisp. Serve with warm peanut sauce.
tips: Chill the shaped patties before frying so the cheese stays enclosed.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
